want: a body and machine crashing hard into the sea: a huge chaotic water crash splash with churning water after
heard: A single moderate-sized object hitting calm water — a clean, punchy splash with a distinct impact, then short, gentle sloshing and lapping as the water settles. Close-miked, dry-ish, no large-scale displacement. The tail is brief and peaceful, just small ripples and sloshing for a couple of seconds before silence.
sounds_like: A person jumping into a swimming pool
problems: Way too small and too clean for the brief. No machine element at all — no metal crunch, no mechanical debris. No chaos: the splash is a single tidy impact, not a huge violent crash. The tail is short and gentle sloshing, not churning water. No sense of the sea — no wave interaction, no large-scale water displacement, no secondary debris settling. Would need heavy layering with a much bigger impact, metal/glass destruction, and a long turbulent water tail to serve this need.
